reviews.text:
Thank you so much for your continued support.

All the instructors are wonderful, and they provide thorough comments and explanations during training!

My child, and I, always look forward to it.

We look forward to continuing our relationship with you.

My dog ​​couldn't even go for a proper walk before, but after just two or three visits here, he's become so good at it, and I'm incredibly grateful to the instructors. Thank you so much for everything!

My child looks forward to going to daycare every week, and is always cheerful and happy in the mornings when they see the teachers' faces. They've also been practicing brushing and teeth cleaning, and their resistance has improved significantly.

I always look forward to the many photos and videos you send of my child playing and being disciplined! (^^)

It's only been about two months since my child started school, but thanks to the teachers, I've already seen a significant change.

They tailor their training methods to my child's age and personality, so they're enjoying going to school.

Attending school has provided positive stimulation, added structure to their daily life, and they seem much more vibrant than before.

I'm so glad I enrolled them.

We started taking our dog to this program to help with his pulling on the leash during walks and to address his lack of exercise.
He loves the school so much that when I say, "Let's go to kindergarten!", he jumps into his bag and wags his tail excitedly, which shows how much love and care the trainers give him.
They also send us photos of expressions we don't usually see and videos with training tips, which is enjoyable for the owner too. I highly recommend it! ✨

The instructors are very kind and gentle, making it a school where I feel completely at ease sending my dog. My dog ​​seems to enjoy going every time, and I think the environment where dogs can communicate with each other is excellent.

They send me photos and updates on the day's training via LINE, which is reassuring because I can see how things are going and it makes it easier to implement what I learn at home.

I can't play with my dog ​​enough because of work, but I'm grateful that the school takes such good care of him. The location right next to the park is also great, and I would like to continue using their services!
My child always enjoys going to the nursery school. The teachers are all kind, so I can leave my naughty child there without worry. I look forward to continuing to work with them.

There's a very kind trainer there!

They give precise advice, which is very reassuring.

They also recently opened a hotel, so I'm thinking of using it. It's really reassuring to know there's a trainer I know at the hotel in case of an emergency. ★

The trainers are incredibly kind and attentive to each individual dog!

I felt completely at ease leaving my dog ​​there, even though it was his first time.

They tailor the training to each dog's needs, so I can see his progress with every visit.

I would definitely like to continue using their services!

The shop had a very bright atmosphere, and the staff were kind and polite.

The dogs seemed relaxed, so it's a reassuring place to leave your dog.

I would like to leave my dog ​​there again in the future.

I'm sending my dog ​​to this school because I want him to interact with other dogs. The teachers are very loving and my dog ​​enjoys going to the school! I think he's learning a lot, little by little, and getting smarter. I'm looking forward to watching him grow up!
My dog ​​loves this school and goes there every month. It's really clear that the trainers all love dogs and treat them with love.
The instructors are very kind and attentive, and my dog ​​seems to enjoy coming every time 🐶💕 It makes me so happy to see him growing little by little. …

My dog ​​used to go to another school, but it's been a while since he stopped going.
My dog ​​will be four this year, and thanks to the teachers, he's growing up healthy and smart again.
Led by Mr. Mori, the teachers always put your dog first. They create training that's right for your dog, so you can send him there with peace of mind.
Also, not just puppies, but grown puppies like my dog ​​are welcome to attend.
It makes me so happy to see my dog ​​looking forward to coming to school every week.
It's new, so it's clean, lets in light from the greenery of the park, and has plenty of bright, spacious play space (even for the teachers). I can take my dog ​​on a walk to school and hold him in my arms as I ride the elevator.

It's been two months since I started sending my dog ​​here, and I can see that his barking, which had been a concern, is gradually improving, so I'm very grateful.
The trainers are cheerful and very thorough, and they explain what my dog ​​did that day while showing us videos, so I feel at ease sending my dog ​​there.
My dog ​​also loves the teachers and is very excited on the day he comes to school.
I look forward to our continued support.
The detailed training feedback, often accompanied by photos and videos, is very helpful. All the trainers are cheerful and kind.

We were a little worried about him moving to a new nursery school and changing his environment, but thanks to the staff, he settled in faster than we expected. Now, in the mornings, he gets into his bag on his own and goes to school happily, which makes us feel at ease.
I came to you for advice on how to correct my dog's habit of pulling on the lead and trying to walk first when we go for a walk.
It's near a park, has a nice view, and is easy to take your dog there!
It's clean and conveniently located near a park!
